title: Logout immediately invalidates the current OMS session
expected: A logged-out session token must immediately return HTTP 401.

title: Logging out one device does not corrupt another valid session
expected: Logout revokes only the selected session and does not terminate another valid login.

title: Trader token cannot access client-admin member data
expected: A trader token must not authorize client-admin member APIs.

title: Reject an unknown MAM allocation method
expected: Unknown allocation methods must be rejected and must not alter the active relationship.

title: Reject zero MAM multiplier
expected: A multiplier less than or equal to zero must be rejected without silently changing it to another value.

title: Reject negative MAM multiplier
expected: A multiplier less than or equal to zero must be rejected without silently changing it to another value.

title: Reject a nonnumeric MAM multiplier
expected: A nonnumeric multiplier must be rejected without altering the relationship.

title: Reject manager performance-share values outside 0–100
expected: Performance-share values outside 0–100 must be rejected without changing the saved fee.

title: Concurrent retry cannot duplicate a pending MAM order
expected: Two concurrent deliveries with the same request_id/group_id must produce exactly one master order and one child order per follower.

title: Arbitrary origins cannot make credentialed OMS requests
expected: The API must not grant credentialed cross-origin access to an arbitrary origin.

title: Authenticated financial data is marked no-store
expected: Authenticated positions and balance data must return Cache-Control: no-store.

title: Trading dashboard sends anti-framing headers
expected: Trading pages must send X-Frame-Options or CSP frame-ancestors to prevent UI redressing.

actual.content_security_policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self'; frame-src https: http://localhost:* http://127.0.0.1:*; frame-ancestors 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'

expected: Case executes and returns a deterministic assertion.
